annotations.text:
Three homepage directions for The Wellness Advocate.
All three drop Fraunces — it is a known AI-tell face — and break the symmetric 3-card grid.
Pick one and I'll build it into the live site.

A — FIELD NOTES · Newsreader + Karla
Magazine feature. Asymmetric 7/5 hero, image plate hangs above the headline baseline, marginalia in the gutter, services as a ruled editorial list with roman numerals.
Most distinctive. Trade-off: the most art direction to maintain.

B — CONSULTING ROOM · EB Garamond + Archivo
Quiet and clinical. No hero image at all — type and white space carry it. Specimen rule of metadata like a printed document.
Safest, most credible. Trade-off: needs excellent photography later or it can read plain.

C — ATRIUM · Bodoni Moda + Jost
Deep green flood, high-contrast Didone display, brass accent, arch as a structural cut rather than a photo frame.
Most luxurious. Trade-off: reads more medspa than medical — may undersell the clinical credibility.
